hero.title: Stress-test your institutions before the real crisis.
hero.lead: AI agents play a country's institutions, each bound by its official mandates and its own documents. ALERTE runs a crisis scenario and reveals coordination failures with evidence: orphan responsibilities, overlapping mandates, missing procedures.

how.title: How it works
how.prepare: Institutions, mandates and legal texts: each agent only knows what its institution knows.
how.play: Events unfold; agents search, coordinate and decide. Every decision must cite a verified text.
how.analyze: Gaps emerge with their evidence chain, then are validated by humans and published as a report.
